messages:
alex_support: hi team, inbound from AcmeCorp — autopay for invoice #98765 failed at billing time. Customer reports card has balance but we see a soft decline + 3DS/ACS behavior. decline_code: do_not_honor, acquirer_response: NO_CHALLENGE from ACS. Can someone triage?

sophia_prodops: thx alex. do we have the raw gateway payload & acs logs? also which route (hosted/dedicated/private)?

alex_support: hosted. patch of relevant API response below. customer saw: 
```json
{
  "status": "declined",
  "decline_code": "do_not_honor",
  "3ds": {
    "acs_result": "NO_CHALLENGE",
    "challenge_requested": false
  },
  "acquirer": {
    "code": "NO_CHALLENGE",
    "message": "ACS responded no challenge required"
  }
}
```

alex_support: they also pasted the browser console during checkout which shows a 3DS redirect that immediately returns without a challenge iframe.

devon_billing: Customer's merchant settings show PO requirement and VAT reconciliation enabled for EU invoices — is this a cross-border card? If tax/VAT metadata mismatches, some acquirers will route to stricter auth flows.

mia_engineer: quick check — NO_CHALLENGE can happen when issuer does frictionless flow. But we shouldn't be getting do_not_honor at the same time. Need full request id and route id to pull KV cache + routing logs. Alex can you share request id?

alex_support: request_id: rq_0a1b2c3d, route: hosted-eu-1. attaching merchant-sent BIN summary: BIN 454321 (EU issuer).

sophia_prodops: I'm pulling the router logs. preliminary shows the request was forwarded to acquirer A with 3DSv2 flag true, but our routing policy also picked fallback to acquirer B after timeout. There's a small 50ms window where the KV cache had stale session -> maybe race.

mia_engineer: can you paste the small snippet from our runtime logs around rq_0a1b2c3d? (no PII)

alex_support: logs below (redacted):
```
[2026-02-14T10:12:02.123Z] rq_0a1b2c3d start route=hosted-eu-1 model=payments  
[2026-02-14T10:12:02.176Z] route->acquirerA 3ds=true session_id=sess_99
[2026-02-14T10:12:02.220Z] acquirerA resp NO_CHALLENGE -> handler returns success=false decline=do_not_honor
[2026-02-14T10:12:02.275Z] fallback->acquirerB triggered after timeout 50ms
[2026-02-14T10:12:02.301Z] acquirerB resp do_not_honor
```

devon_billing: interesting. acquirerA returned NO_CHALLENGE (which normally means frictionless) but response flagged as decline by acquirer logic. Could be issuer-level fraud scoring. Any fraud filters tripped?

mia_engineer: I see in fraud-service trace that device_fingerprint_score was borderline low (0.31) and velocity check flagged repeated attempts in short window. Fraud policy then mapped to 'soft_decline' and we returned do_not_honor upstream.

alex_support: customer insists they only tried once. they use an autopay token saved on file. merchant logs show 1 API call.

sophia_prodops: could be replay from webhook? but router trace only shows single request. devs, is it possible our KV cache stale session triggered fallback that confused the ACS flow leading to mismatch?

mia_engineer: plausible. fallback to acquirerB after partial ACS handshake could present as NO_CHALLENGE then downstream decline. Two actions: 1) engineering to replay the exact request in a dev sandbox against acquirerA/B to confirm behavior, 2) billing to offer a manual retry/workaround to merchant.

devon_billing: for the merchant I'd propose: advise a manual retry (off-session retry) and, if that fails, ask them to reach out to their issuer for a 'do_not_honor' explanation. Also offer to temporarily disable strict VAT reconciliation for that invoice to see if routing changes.

alex_support: merchant asked for repro steps we can run. Mia: could you run a replay with the same BIN + 3DS flag + device_fingerprint set low?

mia_engineer: will do. repro plan: create sandbox charge with BIN 454321, 3DSv2 enabled, set fingerprint score=0.30, route primary->acquirerA fallback->acquirerB, run 3 tries. I'll attach results. ETA 2 hours.

ops-bot: (automated) created ticket PAYOPS-4722 and linked incident to thread.

alex_support: :thumbsup: thank you. Devon, poke merchant and offer manual retry guidance + temporary VAT relax. Also ask for card last4 and auth time to cross-check with issuer.

devon_billing: will do. i sent merchant a DM with steps and asked for last4 + auth timestamp.

sophia_prodops: follow-up — if engineering confirms it's a race between ACS handshake and fallback routing we should: 1) increase soft-fallback window to 200ms for 3DS flows, 2) add instrumentation to flag mixed-acquirer-3ds cases as high-priority. I'll open an infra PR after repro.

mia_engineer: replay done in sandbox: acquirerA returns NO_CHALLENGE -> acquirerB returns do_not_honor when fingerprint low. With increased fallback window set to 200ms the fallback didn't trigger and acquirerA final status was 'frictionless approve' (sandbox). So this matches hypothesis.

alex_support: sharing results with merchant. Devon — merchant accepted manual retry and temporary VAT relax for that invoice; they retried and payment succeeded. Customer asked what we changed.

devon_billing: replied: we retried and temporarily relaxed strict VAT check for the invoice which changed routing; engineering also adjusted fallback window in our sandbox (not prod yet). Merchant is satisfied and payment succeeded.

mia_engineer: next steps: send PR to eng-runtime to increase ephemeral fallback window for 3DS flows to 200ms, add a metric for 'mixed-acquirer-3ds' and a regression test that simulates low fingerprint + acquirer fallback. I'll attach PR link when ready.

alex_support: thanks all. marking thread resolved for now. will keep incident linked if merchant reopens. :white_check_mark:
